bodyBoundary.reference: distributed pad upper face, with the specified material and heat-spreading conditions

qualificationRequired: Pure propane charge and continuous density/Cp/viscosity/conductivity/EOS bounds over actual pressure/temperature history; no dissolved gas or cavitation
Nitrogen compressibility, thermal equilibrium, accumulator expansion/reserve and actual separator deformation/profile/strength/seals
Pad/bonds, aluminium panel conduction/spreading, pressure integrity, restraint support and machined cradle strength
Pinned steel plate integrity, sealed gas vents, actual manifold distribution and all pressure-loss bounds
Manufacture and joint conductivity of the 0.2 mm matrix, pore gas conductivity and distributed CO2 population through depletion
At least half the counted matrix area active, specified gas path length/shape, collector/vent continuity and no local dryout or obstruction
Pump curve/efficiency/rotor/passages, valve flow authority, control stability, temperature/pressure sensing and all heat destinations
Actual preparation/startup temperature, heat timing, source stock, seals, respiration, commissioning and carrier operation authority

requirements: Measure or resolve actual liquid/rotor/valve/diaphragm P and L before stopping
Conserve total P and L through internal stops, transferring fluid/rotor momentum to the body; no velocity reset
Include motor, viscous and stop dissipation in the unchanged electrical/thermal ledger
Resolve actual pump/valve stop and residual fluid motion, local temperature excursion and pressure transients within the quiet bound
Use actual evolving mass distribution in full tensors and dense unilateral/contact/work history; nominal static source states are not admission evidence
quietTransition.closedLoopIdentity: P = massFlow * integral(dr) = 0 for an ideal steady closed circuit; L = massFlow * integral(r cross dr) need not be zero
quietTransition.nominalReferenceOnly: Two flat-diaphragm, microcell-population, quiescent phase configurations; no actual profile or quiet grant
